headline: Inflation in the United States Reaches Highest Level in Three Years in October: PCE Index
summary: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, the PCE price index, reached its highest level in three years in October, according to official data released Wednesday.
why: The PCE index is the inflation measure the Federal Reserve targets, so it heavily influences expectations for US interest rates and Treasury yields.
why_moved: The data showed the Fed's preferred inflation gauge at its highest level in three years, which raises the likelihood of tighter monetary policy.
original_headline: Inflación en Estados Unidos alcanza en octubre su nivel más alto en tres años: Índice PCE
